tickets.title: Reconcile implementation baseline
tickets.work: Select one clean branch containing accepted M5 and the current dashboard, preserve both branch histories and receipt; document conflicts, service revision and rollback.
tickets.done_when: A reviewable merge/baseline exists; M5 receipt and promotion remain intact; real dashboard remains reachable.
verification: git status --short --branch
git log --oneline --graph --all -30

tickets.title: Inventory local Ollama installation
tickets.work: Record real CLI and daemon version, trusted host, process ownership and response bounds without profile or agent mutation.
tickets.done_when: Local version and availability have sanitized real evidence; missing or mismatched service is explicit.
verification: ollama --version

tickets.title: Verify model-host read-only access
tickets.work: Confirm the owner-selected local workstation endpoint and safe read-only access to its existing model; document the exposed surface before requests. The earlier remote-host assumption is superseded.
tickets.done_when: One approved reachable real host and model state, or specific documented blocker; no daemon change or LAN exposure.
verification: read-only host and API discovery; exact command selected after host/trust review

tickets.title: Discover SDK and EAIS account scopes
tickets.work: Use official owner-controlled flows to document each account or shared/team relationship, aliases and key permissions.
tickets.done_when: Two real outcomes or documented actual relationship, captured once privately with no credentials in evidence.
verification: official account and team views; owner-guided once

tickets.title: Validate official cloud balance behavior
tickets.work: Discover GET /api/balance access and real account variants, reset times, rate limits and display precision against provider UI.
tickets.done_when: Each available scope has source/version/role/field/side-effect decision and reconciliation; unavailable remains explicit.
verification: bounded official read-only balance request through approved credentials

tickets.title: Freeze capability and contract decisions
tickets.work: Publish capability matrix and update A03 plan, data flow, source/version/rate, identity, contracts, migration and A03-M7 boundary.
tickets.done_when: Every enabled lane has source decision and contract impact; owner approves exact implementation plan.
verification: python3 tools/automation/run.py AUTO-PLAN-CHECK
python3 tools/automation/run.py AUTO-DOCS-CHECK

tickets.title: Define canonical M6 completion gate
tickets.work: Build versioned M6 completeness catalog and canonical AUTO-M6-EXIT before dependent closure; test blocked/failed/missing evidence.
tickets.done_when: Gate checks M6-A01..A10 and five story deliverables, rejects skipped/missing evidence, emits one sanitized receipt; no repeated owner copy-paste.
verification: python3 tools/automation/run.py AUTO-M6-EXIT

tickets.title: Implement installation and capability admission
tickets.work: Implement provider manifest and installation discovery with separate client/daemon versions, source and compatibility.
tickets.done_when: Each lane independently admits exact supported version/source; invalid lane fails before I/O; real installation produces provenance.
verification: adapter pure policy tests; real installation test (to be defined)

tickets.title: Implement local catalog and loaded-model observation
tickets.work: Use bounded local GET version/tags/ps sources, map installed and loaded models with source/time and real empty/offline states.
tickets.done_when: Actual empty and real model-present cases render distinctly; no inference/loading request or mutation.
verification: real local service integration tests and browser checks (to be defined)

tickets.title: Integrate accounts, identity and authentication health
tickets.work: Use provider-neutral registry CRUD for SDK/EAIS aliases and source-backed identity/auth; preserve unknown and existing history.
tickets.done_when: User can add, assign and enable accounts, with verified/unresolved/auth-required status and no hardcoded accounts.
verification: real SQLite/API and real account identity checks (to be defined)

tickets.title: Map real cloud balance and legacy windows
tickets.work: Map official balance variants with exact decimal money, native legacy windows, scope and reset; enforce shared account limit and 429 backoff.
tickets.done_when: Owner-visible real data reconciles within documented precision and lag; included/purchased/shared not conflated.
verification: pure mapping tests plus real cloud reconciliation (to be defined)

tickets.title: Persist capacity history and alert events
tickets.owner: M04 collection + M05 capacity + M07 alerts
tickets.work: Commit real source observations idempotently to existing capacity history and derive configured alerts.
tickets.done_when: Real account reading reaches API, history, chart and genuine alert lifecycle as available; duplicate processing does not duplicate observation.
verification: real SQLite, HTTP and built-browser history/alert tests (to be defined)

tickets.title: Discover real Ollama processes and correlation
tickets.work: Read approved process metadata, distinguish loaded model and active client, preserve evidence-backed hierarchy and unresolved links.
tickets.done_when: Representative real processes display correct sampled state/paths where permitted; no environment, prompt, response, source or process mutation.
verification: real Linux process and provider checks (to be defined)

tickets.title: Implement dashboard views and provider filter
tickets.work: Render Ollama account, organization, resource type, values, source, freshness, model/process and failure states via versioned API.
tickets.done_when: Real Overview/detail/filter/history accessible on desktop and mobile; no placeholder values; existing promotion retained.
verification: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
real dashboard browser checks (to be defined)

tickets.title: Verify failure isolation and natural recovery
tickets.work: Exercise available real auth/offline/throttle/recovery conditions without stopping a user service, and verify Claude/Codex/dashboard continuity.
tickets.done_when: Observed conditions pass with source/time; absent natural conditions remain Blocked/Not Run without simulation.
verification: real service and provider failure-isolation checks (to be defined)

tickets.title: Security, compatibility and dependency review
tickets.work: Review request scopes, secrets, allowed fields, no default-profile mutation, no agent control, dependencies/license and versioned contracts.
tickets.done_when: Review names each finding and resolution; no mandatory security/privacy blocker remains; no new dependency without approval.
verification: python3 tools/automation/run.py AUTO-QUALITY
bounded source and existing-evidence security/privacy review

tickets.title: Run live end-to-end M6 scenarios
tickets.work: Run fixed real test catalog and source-to-history/dashboard comparisons across SDK, EAIS and model host.
tickets.done_when: Record exact observed pass/block outcomes, no hidden skips and no repeated owner attestations for unchanged evidence.
verification: python3 tools/automation/run.py AUTO-M6-EXIT

tickets.title: Deploy, operate and close M6
tickets.work: Run canonical gate, one bounded independent review, safe dashboard rollout/rollback and owner demonstration; record acceptance.
tickets.done_when: Gate passed at exact revision, service responds, promotion retained, runbook updated, owner reviews once; M7/M8 remain separate.
verification: python3 tools/automation/run.py AUTO-M6-EXIT
python3 tools/automation/run.py AUTO-DOCS-CHECK
